title: The Recipe's Last Line
summaryZh: Noah 和外祖母循著錄音中的鐘聲來到社區廚房，在舊計時器與櫥櫃間找出食譜最後一步，也重新理解 Mateo 留下的真正祕訣。

sentences.text: The next morning, Noah and Elena arrived at the community center before its first class began.
sentences.zh: 隔天早上，Noah 和 Elena 在第一堂課開始前抵達社區中心。

sentences.text: The building had been renovated, but the same twelve bells rang from the tower across the street.
sentences.zh: 建築物已經整修過，但街對面塔樓仍響起同樣的十二下鐘聲。

sentences.text: Mrs. Park, a retired cooking teacher, welcomed them with a dusty binder and a ring of keys.
sentences.zh: 退休烹飪老師 Park 太太帶著一本積灰塵的資料夾和一串鑰匙歡迎他們。

sentences.text: She remembered Mateo clearly because he told jokes whenever students became nervous about making mistakes.
sentences.zh: 她清楚記得 Mateo，因為每當學生因害怕犯錯而緊張時，他就會說笑話。

sentences.text: Unfortunately, the binder held attendance sheets and shopping receipts, but none of his stew recipes.
sentences.zh: 可惜資料夾裡只有點名表和購物收據，沒有任何一份他的燉菜食譜。

sentences.text: Several boxes of lesson cards had been moved or discarded when the kitchen was remodeled.
sentences.zh: 廚房改建時，有好幾箱教學卡片被移走或丟棄了。

sentences.text: Elena tried to hide her disappointment, saying that hearing Mateo's voice once was already a gift.
sentences.zh: Elena 試著隱藏失望，說能再聽見 Mateo 的聲音一次就已經是禮物。

sentences.text: Noah asked to play the recording inside the kitchen before they ended their search.
sentences.zh: Noah 請求先在廚房裡播放錄音，再結束搜尋。

sentences.text: As the file played, children's singing drifted through an open window from the center's small yard.
sentences.zh: 檔案播放時，孩子們的歌聲從中心的小庭院飄進敞開的窗戶。

sentences.text: The noon bells sounded next, exactly as they had behind Mateo's unfinished sentence.
sentences.zh: 接著中午的鐘聲響起，和 Mateo 未完成句子後方的聲音完全相同。

sentences.text: Both noises were loudest beside an old pantry at the back of the teaching kitchen.
sentences.zh: 這兩種聲音在教學廚房後方的一間舊食品儲藏室旁最為清楚。

sentences.text: Mrs. Park suddenly recalled that Mateo kept recipe notes near a red timer on the pantry shelf.
sentences.zh: Park 太太忽然想起，Mateo 以前會把食譜筆記放在儲藏室架上的紅色計時器旁。

sentences.text: The timer had been placed in storage, so the three of them began opening labeled boxes.
sentences.zh: 那個計時器已被放進倉庫，所以三個人開始打開貼有標籤的箱子。

sentences.text: They found it beneath a stack of aprons, yet there was no recipe card beside it.
sentences.zh: 他們在一疊圍裙下找到計時器，但旁邊並沒有食譜卡。

sentences.text: Noah removed its loose battery cover and discovered a narrow strip of paper folded underneath.
sentences.zh: Noah 取下鬆動的電池蓋，發現底下摺著一張窄紙條。

sentences.text: The strip listed the familiar ingredients, with one puzzling note written across the bottom.
sentences.zh: 紙條列出他們熟悉的材料，底部還橫寫著一句令人不解的註記。

sentences.text: In Mateo's handwriting, the note said, "The last line is where every pot waits."
sentences.zh: 紙條上以 Mateo 的字跡寫著：「最後一句就在每一口鍋等待的地方。」

sentences.text: Elena thought it was another joke, but Mrs. Park looked toward a low wooden shelf near the sink.
sentences.zh: Elena 以為那又是一個玩笑，Park 太太卻望向水槽旁的一個低矮木架。

sentences.text: After cooking lessons, students had always placed their covered pots there before serving the food.
sentences.zh: 烹飪課結束後，學生總會先把蓋好的鍋子放在那裡，再端菜上桌。

sentences.text: The wooden shelf had been removed during renovation, but the old cabinet that had supported it remained in place.
sentences.zh: 木架在整修時已被移除，但原本支撐它的舊櫥櫃仍留在原位。

sentences.text: When they opened the cabinet, they found faded writing beneath a removable safety notice inside the door.
sentences.zh: 他們打開櫥櫃，在櫃門內側一張可撕下的安全告示底下發現褪色字跡。

sentences.text: It read, "Turn off the heat, keep the lid closed, and wait ten full minutes."
sentences.zh: 上面寫著：「關火、保持鍋蓋緊閉，然後等足整整十分鐘。」

sentences.text: There was no rare spice or secret sauce, only a patient pause after the cooking ended.
sentences.zh: 那裡沒有稀有香料或祕密醬汁，只有烹調結束後一段耐心的等待。

sentences.text: Elena laughed as she realized why her own version had always seemed thinner and less fragrant.
sentences.zh: Elena 笑了，因為她終於明白自己的版本為何總是比較稀，也沒有那麼香。

sentences.text: Mrs. Park let them use the kitchen, and together they prepared the stew from the recovered instructions.
sentences.zh: Park 太太讓他們使用廚房，三人便按照找回的步驟一起準備燉菜。

sentences.text: Noah chopped vegetables, Elena measured herbs, and Mrs. Park watched the beans soften over low heat.
sentences.zh: Noah 切蔬菜，Elena 測量香草用量，Park 太太則看著豆子以小火慢慢變軟。

sentences.text: When the burner was turned off, Noah wanted to lift the lid after only five minutes.
sentences.zh: 爐火關掉後才過五分鐘，Noah 就想掀開鍋蓋。

sentences.text: Elena stopped his hand, and they waited while the room slowly filled with rosemary and lemon.
sentences.zh: Elena 阻止了他的手，他們耐心等待，房間也漸漸充滿迷迭香與檸檬的氣味。

sentences.text: At ten minutes, the stew had become richer, and its separate flavors finally tasted like one dish.
sentences.zh: 十分鐘後，燉菜變得更濃郁，原本各自分明的味道終於融合成一道完整料理。

sentences.text: Noah photographed the hidden sentence, typed the complete recipe, and attached Mateo's recording with a transcript.
sentences.zh: Noah 拍下那句隱藏文字、打出完整食譜，並附上 Mateo 的錄音與逐字稿。

sentences.text: He saved copies online, on a drive, and on paper so one broken device could never erase them.
sentences.zh: 他將副本存在線上、硬碟和紙張上，讓一台故障裝置再也無法抹去它們。

sentences.text: At dinner, Elena said Mateo's final lesson was not about an ingredient, but about giving good things time.
sentences.zh: 晚餐時，Elena 說 Mateo 最後留下的課程不是關於某種材料，而是要給美好的事物足夠時間。

questions.q: Why did Noah play the recording in the teaching kitchen?
options: He wanted to compare its background sounds with the room
He needed music for the first cooking class
He wanted Mrs. Park to repair the audio file

questions.q: Where did they find Mateo's final cooking instruction?
options: Under a safety notice in an old cabinet
On the back of an attendance sheet

questions.q: What was Mateo's real secret for the stew?
options: Adding a rare spice before serving
Cooking the beans over high heat
Letting the covered pot rest for ten minutes
